title: BIM Modeler
description:
**Job Title:** BIM Architect  
**Experience:** 6 months to 2 years

**Location:** Ahmedabad

**About Us:**

At UBP we are a leading BIM service provider working on diverse projects across the Sweden, UK, UAE, France, Australia, Netherlands and Canada. We specialize in delivering high-quality architectural modelling, restoration, facility management, and Scan-to-BIM services. Join our growing team of passionate professionals dedicated to shaping the future of digital construction.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior BIM Architect with a minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in Autodesk Revit. The ideal candidate should have an academic background in B.Arch., Diploma in Architecture, or a related field in the AEC industry.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Develop accurate and detailed architectural BIM models using Autodesk Revit.

· Model topography and architectural elements based on provided data and project requirements.

· Understand and follow architecture discipline standards and coordination workflows.

· Work efficiently in a central model environment and collaborate through BIM 360.

· Prepare sheet layouts, annotations, and presentation drawings according to project standards.

· Handle phasing work for renovation/restoration and new construction projects.

· Coordinate with project leads and follow defined BIM execution plans.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

· Educational Qualification: B.Arch. / Diploma in Architecture / related field in the AEC industry.

· Minimum 1 year of working experience in Autodesk Revit.

· Sound understanding of architectural modelling standards and BIM workflows.

· Proficient in topography modelling and working with site-related elements.

· Experience in working with central files and BIM 360 for team collaboration.

· Knowledge of sheet setup, detailing, and annotation standards.

· Familiarity with phases and design options in Revit.

· Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality deliverables.

· Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have):

· Understanding of AutoCAD Software.

· Experience in international projects (US/UK/UAE/Australia/Canada) is advantage.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: HVAC Design Engineer – Pharmaceutical / Cleanroom Projects
description:
**Company:** JD Pharma Consultants  
**Job Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Experience:** 3–10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Industry:** Pharmaceutical Engineering / Cleanroom / HVAC Design

About the Role

JD Pharma Consultants is looking for an experienced **HVAC Design Engineer** with strong technical expertise in HVAC system design for Pharmaceutical, Cleanroom, and controlled-environment projects.

We are seeking candidates with hands-on experience in HVAC design calculations, equipment selection, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform HVAC heat load calculations and cooling load estimation using HAP, Carrier, or TRACE.
* Design HVAC systems for pharmaceutical facilities, cleanrooms, and controlled environments.
* Prepare AHU selection, duct sizing, duct layouts, airflow calculations, and ventilation designs.
* Develop HVAC drawings, equipment layouts, technical specifications, BOQs, and design documentation.
* Work on cleanroom classification, pressure differentials, air changes per hour (ACH), temperature, and humidity requirements.
* Coordinate with architects, MEP teams, vendors, and project execution teams.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable GMP, ISO 14644, WHO, and pharmaceutical engineering standards.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **3–10 years of relevant HVAC Design experience.**
* Strong knowledge of HVAC design calculations, AHU, ducting, airflow, and equipment selection.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and HVAC design software such as HAP, Carrier, or TRACE.
* Experience in preparing HVAC BOQs, technical specifications, and engineering drawings.
* Good understanding of cleanroom HVAC design and pharmaceutical industry requirements.
* Strong technical coordination and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience working with Pharmaceutical Engineering Consultants, Cleanroom Design Companies, HVAC Design Consultants, or MEP Engineering Firms.
* Hands-on involvement in HVAC design rather than only site execution or maintenance.
* Familiarity with GMP-compliant pharmaceutical facilities and cleanroom requirements.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:

**hr.amd@jdpharmaconsultants.co.in**

**Email Subject:** Application – HVAC Design Engineer – Ahmedabad

Please mention your total experience, relevant HVAC design experience, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.

**Join JD Pharma Consultants and contribute to pharmaceutical and cleanroom engineering projects.**

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹46,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
